findings.title: Knee Arthroplasty in Adults (7.01.550)
findings.quote: Documentation of three months of failed non-operative, conservative management for Kellgren-Lawrence grade 3 findings as demonstrated by a trial of one or more of the following medications
findings.note: Fetched PDF; full MN criteria incl. Kellgren-Lawrence grading, pain/function, conservative care.

findings.title: Hip Arthroplasty in Adults (7.01.573)
findings.quote: Documentation of three months of failed non-operative conservative management as demonstrated by a trial of one or more of the following medications
findings.note: Fetched PDF; criteria incl. Tonnis grade 3 radiographs, 3-mo pain, 12-wk conservative care.

findings.title: Shoulder Arthroscopy in Adults (7.01.602)
findings.quote: Documentation of three months of failed non-operative, conservative management as demonstrated by a trial of one or more of the following medications
findings.note: Fetched PDF; includes rotator cuff repair criteria (imaging-confirmed tear, 3-mo conservative care incl. 6 wks PT).

findings.title: Shoulder Arthroplasty (7.01.590)
findings.quote: Documentation of three months of failed non-operative conservative management as demonstrated by a trial of one or more of the following: Anti-inflammatory medications or analgesics
findings.note: Fetched PDF; criteria incl. >=3-mo disabling pain/functional disability, radiographic destructive changes, 6 wks PT.

findings.title: Knee Arthroscopy in Adults (7.01.549)
findings.quote: Symptoms have not responded to 2 weeks of conservative care (e.g., physical therapy [PT], activity modification, oral analgesics)
findings.note: Fetched PDF; ACL-specific criteria (positive Lachman/pivot shift/drawer or MRI-confirmed tear plus one qualifying factor).

findings.title: Lumbar Spinal Fusion in Adults (7.01.542)
findings.quote: Neurogenic claudication or radicular pain that results in significant functional impairment in an individual who has failed at least 3 months of conservative care
findings.note: Fetched PDF; indication-by-indication criteria with imaging and conservative-care requirements.

findings.title: Cervical Spine Surgeries: Discectomy, Laminectomy, and Fusion in Adults (7.01.560)
findings.quote: Symptoms have been unresponsive to at least 6 weeks of conservative nonsurgical therapy, including ALL of the following:
findings.note: Fetched PDF; ACDF/cervical fusion MN criteria with conservative care and imaging concordance.

findings.title: Total Ankle Arthroplasty in Adults (7.01.599)
findings.quote: Disabling pain for at least 3 months duration, and Functional disability of the ankle joint, which interferes with the ability to carry out activities of daily living (ADLs)
findings.note: Fetched PDF; full MN criteria for TAA.
No Premera medical policy for bunionectomy/hallux valgus located (policy set covers other MSK surgery; searches of premera.com/medicalpolicies found none).

findings.title: Surgical Treatment of Femoroacetabular Impingement (7.01.592)
findings.quote: Unresponsive to conservative therapy for at least 3 months (including activity modifications, restriction of athletic pursuits, and avoidance of symptomatic motion)
findings.note: Fetched PDF; FAI/hip arthroscopy criteria incl. alpha angle >50, positive impingement signs, Tonnis/Outerbridge exclusions.

findings.title: Lumbar Spine Decompression Surgery: Discectomy, Foraminotomy, Laminotomy, Laminectomy in Adults (7.01.551)
findings.quote: Symptoms have been unresponsive to at least 6 weeks of conservative nonsurgical care, including ALL of the following
findings.note: Fetched PDF; decompression/discectomy MN criteria with imaging-symptom correlation.

findings.title: Carelon Medical Benefits Management (Premera utilization review page)
findings.note: Premera delegates advanced imaging (MRI/CT) prior auth to Carelon Medical Benefits Management; page links Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines (guidelines.carelonmedicalbenefitsmanagement.com). No Premera-authored MRI criteria.
No TKA policy in Regence Medical Policy Manual. SUR229 Knee Surgeries (eff. 3/1/2026, fetched) covers partial knee arthroplasty etc. and discusses TKA only as comparator; no TKA criteria published.
No hip arthroplasty policy located in Regence Medical Policy Manual (surgery section probed; no 'Hip Surgeries'/arthroplasty policy found).

findings.title: Shoulder Surgeries, Surgery Policy No. 228 (SUR228)
findings.quote: Documentation of function-limiting pain (e.g., loss of shoulder function which interferes with the ability to carry out activities of daily living and/or demands of employment)
findings.note: Fetched PDF (URL 302s to Bynder-hosted document); covers rotator cuff repair, labral repair, SAD, etc.; explicitly excludes arthroplasty.
No shoulder arthroplasty policy: SUR228 Shoulder Surgeries (fetched) states arthroplasty is not addressed; no separate arthroplasty policy located.
No ACL reconstruction criteria in Regence manual; SUR229 Knee Surgeries mentions ACL integrity only as an exclusion for partial knee arthroplasty.

findings.title: Lumbar Spinal Fusion, Surgery Policy No. 187 (SUR187)
findings.quote: There is clinical documentation that a minimum of three months of conservative nonoperative therapy failed to adequately treat the individual's current symptoms
findings.note: Fetched PDF (URL 302s to Bynder-hosted document); detailed indication, imaging and conservative-care criteria.
No cervical fusion/ACDF policy located in Regence Medical Policy Manual.
No total ankle arthroplasty/replacement policy located in Regence Medical Policy Manual.
No bunionectomy/hallux valgus policy located in Regence Medical Policy Manual.

findings.title: Femoroacetabular Impingement Surgery, Surgery Policy No. 160 (SUR160)
findings.quote: Positive impingement sign on clinical examination (i.e., pain elicited with 90 degrees of flexion and internal rotation and adduction of the femur)
findings.note: Fetched PDF (URL 302s to Bynder-hosted document); FAI surgery criteria incl. alpha angle >50 degrees, >=3-mo conservative therapy.
No standalone lumbar decompression/discectomy policy located; SUR187 addresses fusion only.

No MSK MRI policy in Regence manual. regence.com pre-authorization page metadata references eviCore (radiology) and Carelon programs, but vendor assignment for advanced imaging could not be verified from public pages (site is script-rendered).

findings.title: InterQual and SmartSheets (Wellmark provider page)
findings.note: Wellmark publishes an A-Z medical policy list (fetched) but has no policy for this procedure; Wellmark states it uses InterQual criteria (Change Healthcare) for medical-necessity review. InterQual is proprietary: in-state providers view via provider portal, out-of-state via SmartSheets request form. Per-code PA status: authorization.wellmark.com/authtable/.
